question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Poems.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 In the **first** line of the passage:

 
 
• *'A poet visited Tenali Raman hoping to impress him with some poems he had written.'*
 
• **'Poems**' would be the correct option as it is clearly written in the above line that the poet visited Raman with some poems he had written for him.
 
 
 
• 
 The correct sentence is, *'When he woke up, the poet asked: “Sir, shall I read the poems again?".*
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **'Poems'.**
 
• Hence, the correct option is **3**.

Correct Paragraph__: *A poet visited Tenali Raman hoping to impress him with some poems he had written. Raman asked __him__ to leave the poems with him and promised to read them __later__. The man, however, insisted on __reading__ out the poems to him. As the poet droned __on__ Raman fell asleep. When he woke up, the poet asked: “Sir, shall I read the __**poems**__ again?"*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

 
• 
 गद्यांश की **पहली** पंक्ति में:

 
 
• 
 *'एक कवि तेनाली रमन से मिलने आया, इस उम्मीद में कि वह अपनी लिखी कुछ कविताओं से उन्हें प्रभावित करेगा।'*
 
 
• 
 'कविता' (poems) सही विकल्प होगा क्योंकि उपरोक्त पंक्ति में स्पष्ट रूप से लिखा गया है कि कवि रमन के पास उनके लिए लिखी गई कुछ कविताओं को लेकर आया था।
 
 
 
 
• 
 सही वाक्य है,* '**'When he woke up, the poet asked: “Sir, shall I read the poems again?"*
 
 
• 
 अतः इसका सही उत्तर** 'poems' **है।
 
 
• 
 अत: सही विकल्प **3 (option 3)** है।
